copy_inventory_entry_rule: Exactly one identical record for the genuine manifest and every manifest member, with unique original and local paths; provider/hostname/repository match the actual donor. Bound source-copy review evidence must be genuine and independently reviewed.
future_enabled_D2_requirement: Existing D2 v2 remains untouched. Before enabled numerical use, independently review a D2 source successor that authenticates the sealed v2 collector/inventory and complete supplemental executable dependency/supervisor/source-copy/process closure within its all39 custody gate before FREEZE semantic parsing, histories/selectors or tensors.
gpu77_launch_schema: Actual emitter launch_blocks_once.py uses ONE_COMPLETE_ROOT_RELEASED_BLOCK_QUEUE_LAUNCHED, pilot_source_manifest_sha256, root_release_sha256, observed_cwd, identity_admitted_for_signals, attempts=1 and retry=false.
original30_logical_admission_references_: Original admission source references retain original provider paths/hashes. Genuine local copies are matched by retrospective source-copy provenance; no rewrite of admission or canonical namespace is required.
original30_process_locations: Actual donor QUEUE_START.json and logs/<cell>.CHILD_STARTED.json/.EXIT.json via the original authenticated ordinary donor replica; each supplemental path must equal that source-fixed replica path.
same_host_time_checks: Only queue-start <= child-start <= owned EXIT from the same bound actual donor; no cross-host order inference.
singleton_launch_schema: Actual emitter stage_and_launch.py uses source_manifest_sha256/release_sha256 and queue_identity.cwd; it has no GPU77 named status/attempts/identity-admitted fields. Its queue cwd is the source-fixed Popen cwd declaration, not a separately recorded /proc cwd observation.
source_reference_meaning: original_path is the immutable executed provider phase-relative path; path is an ordinary genuine local phase file, with identical pinned bytes. copy_inventory binds separately reviewed retrospective acquisition/copy evidence. No symlink, source rewrite, source-manifest replacement, namespace alias or invented historical admission is admitted.
